learning_outcomes.text: Introduce students to the main concepts related to computer science from both a "cultural" and a technological point of view.
Introduce the student to the fundamental aspects of computer science, such as algorithms, languages, programs, the general structure of computers, and the representation of information.
Give notions on the fundamentals of information theory and computer architecture.
Teach the fundamentals of programming and the use of a programming language for a computer, the C language, as a tool for solving real problems.

syllabus_topics: FUNCTIONAL STRUCTURE OF THE HARDWARE MACHINE
GRAMMAR AND LANGUAGES, SYNTAX AND SEMANTICS REPRESENTATION OF THE INFORMATION
REPRESENTATION OF REAL NUMBERS IN FLOATING-POINT STRUCTURE AND BASIC ELEMENTS OF A C PROGRAM
CONDITIONAL CONTROL-FLOW STRUCTURES: IF and SWITCH, BREAK and CONTINUE
ITERATIVE INSTRUCTIONS: WHILE, DO WHILE and FOR
ABSTRACTION OF OPERATIONS AND PROGRAMMING FOR REFINEMENT
DECLARATION, DEFINITION AND CALLING OF A FUNCTION
VISIBILITY AND LIFETIME OF THE IDENTIFIERS
MATHEMATICAL FUNCTIONS and CHARACTERS FUNCTIONS POINTERS
FUNCTIONS: PASSAGE OF PARAMETERS BY REFERENCE STRUCTURED DATA
DYNAMIC ARRAYS: MEMORY ALLOCATION AND DEALLOCATION
SORTING A VECTOR and DICHOTOMIC SEARCH
STRINGS AND ARRAY of STRINGS DATA PERSISTENCE
SEQUENTIAL ACCESS AND DIRECT ACCESS TO THE FILE STRUCTURED DATA
